meta.title: Camping Night on the School Field

paragraphs: Camping Night on the School Field. This leaflet was written by Mia and Leo, and Teacher Kim checked it. It is for the children of the last year of primary school and their parents. Our school has a camping night on one Saturday, and it is a big school event for everybody. You sleep in a tent on the school field, and your friends sleep next to you. Is it your first time? Do not worry, because the teachers stay with you all night.

What to Bring. Bring a sleeping bag, a pillow, a flashlight, and a warm shirt for the night. Write your name clearly on every bag. The school has tents for you, so you bring less than on a long trip. Do not bring a phone or a video game. We want you to talk to your friends instead.

The Plan for the Evening. First, come to the school gate at four o'clock, and help to put up the tents. At five o'clock, Coach Matt starts a football game on the field. The teams are mixed on the field, so a win is a question of luck. After that, we eat supper together at half past six. Then Leo starts a spelling game with the names of animals, and each team gets a card. At eight o'clock, we watch a short film outside on a big white sheet. After the film, we discuss it in small groups.

The Night and the Morning. At nine o'clock, everybody goes to the tents and the lights go out. Two teachers sit near the tents and watch the field until morning. We wake at six o'clock on Sunday, and we take down the tents. Then we eat breakfast in the school hall. Parents come to the gate at eight o'clock, and the camp ends.

Rules. Stay in your tent after nine o'clock. Do not leave the field without a teacher. Tell a teacher at once if you feel ill. Keep the field clean, and put your bottle in the bin. Walk, do not run, near the tents, because the ropes are hard to see.

Price and Joining. The camp costs one hundred baht, and this is less than a ticket to the cinema. The price pays for supper, breakfast, and the film. Ask a parent to sign the note, and give it to Teacher Kim. We hope to see you there. Good luck with the packing!
